Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human target Chromobox protein homolog 1 (CHEMBL1741193). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1741193 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require structures via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
